title: 🔥 FALSE CHRISTIANS EXPOSED: THEY CALL JESUS 'LORD' BUT REFUSE TO OBEY HIM!
paragraphs:
🔥 FALSE CHRISTIANS EXPOSED: THEY CALL JESUS 'LORD' BUT REFUSE TO OBEY HIM!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I see many people who call themselves Christians, but they don’t obey Jesus. They go to church, celebrate religious traditions, and say, ‘Lord, Lord,’ but their lives don’t match the Bible. Can someone truly be a Christian if they refuse to follow Christ’s commands?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people claim to be Christians, but their actions prove otherwise. They wear crosses, post Bible verses online, and sit in church every Sunday—but when you compare their lives to Scripture, you see compromise, disobedience, and a love for man-made traditions!

📖 Luke 6:46 (KJV)
"And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?"

🚨 THE REALITY:
✔️ Many so-called "Christians" follow their church leaders more than Christ Himself!
✔️ They trust in religious traditions instead of studying the Bible for themselves!
✔️ They claim to love Jesus, yet they ignore His teachings and commands!

🔥 BUT HERE’S THE HARSH TRUTH:
📖 Matthew 7:21 (KJV)
"Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven."
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly following Jesus, or just following what your church tells you?
THE SIGNS OF FALSE CHRISTIANITY – HOW TO IDENTIFY RELIGIOUS HYPOCRISY!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how do we recognize false Christians? What are the signs that someone claims to follow Christ but actually follows man-made religion?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Jesus warned that not everyone who claims to follow Him is truly saved. Many people think they are Christians simply because they attend church, follow traditions, or say religious words—but their hearts are far from God!

📖 Matthew 15:8-9 (KJV)
"This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me. But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men."
🚨 HERE ARE THE SIGNS OF A FALSE CHRISTIAN:

1️⃣ THEY CLAIM TO KNOW JESUS, BUT THEY DO NOT OBEY HIS WORD!
🔥 They say they love Jesus, but they reject His commands!

📖 1 John 2:4 (KJV)
"He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him."

✔️ They go to church, but their hearts are filled with sin!
✔️ They say “I believe in God,” but they live like the world!
✔️ They refuse to repent because they love their sin more than Jesus!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If you don’t obey Jesus, you don’t truly know Him!
💡 QUESTION: Do you follow Jesus with your life, or just with your lips?

2️⃣ THEY PUT MAN-MADE TRADITIONS ABOVE THE BIBLE!
🔥 They follow their church rules, but not God’s commands!

📖 Mark 7:7-8 (KJV)
"Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men. For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men."

✔️ They believe religious rituals will save them, instead of faith in Christ!
✔️ They follow church laws that contradict the Bible!
✔️ They celebrate traditions that have no biblical foundation!
🚨 THE TRUTH: Religion cannot save you—only Jesus can!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following Christ, or are you blindly following religious traditions?

3️⃣ THEY FOLLOW THEIR CHURCH LEADERS BLINDLY, BUT NEVER STUDY THE BIBLE FOR THEMSELVES!
🔥 They trust their pastors, priests, and religious leaders more than they trust Scripture!

📖 Acts 17:11 (KJV)
"These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so."

✔️ They accept everything their leaders say without checking if it aligns with the Bible!
✔️ They defend their church’s teachings, even when Scripture proves them wrong!
✔️ They never open the Bible, yet they argue about what it says!
🚨 THE TRUTH: A true Christian seeks the truth in GOD’S WORD, not in religious institutions!
💡 QUESTION: Are you studying the Bible for yourself, or are you letting others think for you?

4️⃣ THEY LIVE LIKE THE WORLD BUT CALL THEMSELVES BELIEVERS!
🔥 They go to church on Sunday, but live in sin the rest of the week!

📖 James 4:4 (KJV)
"Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God."

✔️ They drink, party, and commit immorality, but still say, “God knows my heart!”
✔️ They justify their sin by saying, “Nobody’s perfect,” instead of repenting!
✔️ They want God’s blessings, but they don’t want to surrender to Him!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If your life looks no different from an unbeliever, then you are NOT following Christ!
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly set apart for God, or are you still living like the world?

5️⃣ THEY GET OFFENDED WHEN THE TRUTH EXPOSES THEIR DECEPTION!
🔥 When confronted with Scripture, they get angry instead of repenting!

📖 Galatians 4:16 (KJV)
"Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?"

✔️ They get defensive when their false beliefs are challenged!
✔️ They accuse true Christians of being "judgmental" for exposing deception!
✔️ They attack those who preach the truth instead of examining their own hearts!
🚨 THE TRUTH: A true Christian humbles themselves before God’s Word—only the proud reject correction!
💡 QUESTION: Do you humble yourself before God’s Word, or do you reject truth when it convicts you?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE UNDERSTAND THE SIGNS OF FALSE CHRISTIANITY, WHAT DOES JESUS SAY WILL HAPPEN TO THEM?
JESUS’ WARNING TO FALSE CHRISTIANS – THE FATE OF THE DISOBEDIENT!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what does Jesus say will happen to those who claim to be Christians but refuse to obey Him?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many think that just because they call themselves "Christians," they are guaranteed a place in heaven. But Jesus HIMSELF warned that on Judgment Day, MANY will be rejected! They thought they were saved, but they had deceived themselves!

📖 Matthew 7:21-23 (KJV)
"Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven. Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

🚨 THINK ABOUT THAT!
✔️ These people called Jesus ‘Lord,’ but they were still REJECTED!
✔️ They did religious works, but they did not OBEY His Word!
✔️ Jesus DID NOT say, “I once knew you but you fell away.” He said, “I NEVER KNEW YOU!”
🔥 THEY WERE NEVER TRULY HIS—THEIR FAITH WAS FAKE!
💡 QUESTION: Will Jesus recognize you as His true follower, or will He say, ‘I never knew you’?

✅ 1. JESUS SAID ONLY THOSE WHO OBEY GOD WILL ENTER HEAVEN!
🔥 Lip service is NOT enough—obedience is required!

📖 John 14:15 (KJV)
"If ye love me, keep my commandments."

✔️ Many claim to love Jesus but ignore His commands!
✔️ If you refuse to follow Him, your so-called ‘faith’ is DEAD!
✔️ True salvation produces OBEDIENCE!
🚨 THE TRUTH: A true believer doesn’t just "believe in God"—they LIVE for Him!
💡 QUESTION: Are you obeying Christ in your daily life, or are you just wearing the Christian label?

✅ 2. RELIGIOUS WORKS CANNOT SAVE YOU—ONLY A TRUE RELATIONSHIP WITH CHRIST CAN!
🔥 Going to church, praying, and doing good deeds will NOT save you!

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV)
"For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."

✔️ Many think that because they "do good things," they are saved.
✔️ They are RELIGIOUS, but they have no true RELATIONSHIP with Jesus!
✔️ True salvation is by FAITH ALONE—works come as a result of that faith!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If your faith doesn’t change your life, it is a DEAD FAITH!
💡 QUESTION: Are you trusting in religious activities, or do you truly KNOW Jesus?

✅ 3. JESUS WARNED THAT MANY WILL BE SHOCKED ON JUDGMENT DAY!
🔥 Many THINK they are saved, but will be rejected!

📖 Luke 13:24-27 (KJV)
"Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able... Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets. But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity."

✔️ Many will be SHOCKED that they are not saved!
✔️ They thought religious activities were enough, but they had NO true obedience!
✔️ Jesus will tell them, "I never knew you—DEPART FROM ME!"
🚨 THE TRUTH: Being "religious" doesn’t mean you are right with God!
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly saved, or are you deceiving yourself?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE UNDERSTAND JESUS’ WARNING, WHAT MUST WE DO TO ENSURE WE ARE TRULY FOLLOWING HIM?
HOW TO BE A TRUE CHRISTIAN – FOLLOWING JESUS IN TRUTH!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if so many people are deceived, how can I make sure that I am truly following Jesus the right way?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The Bible makes it clear that not everyone who calls themselves a Christian is truly saved. If you want to be 100% sure that you are following Jesus the way He commanded, then you must do what He actually said—not what man-made religion teaches!

📖 John 8:31 (KJV)
"If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed."
🚨 HERE’S HOW TO BE A TRUE FOLLOWER OF JESUS!

✅ 1. STOP FOLLOWING RELIGION AND START FOLLOWING CHRIST!
🔥 Jesus did NOT come to start a religion—He came to bring people back to God!

📖 John 14:6 (KJV)
"Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me."

✔️ True Christianity is about having a real relationship with Jesus—not following church traditions!
✔️ Many people trust their church more than they trust the Bible!
✔️ A true Christian follows Christ ALONE—not religious systems!
🚨 THE TRUTH: Your faith must be in JESUS, not in a religious institution!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following Christ alone, or are you trapped in religion?

✅ 2. STUDY THE BIBLE FOR YOURSELF – DON’T JUST TRUST WHAT OTHERS SAY!
🔥 Most people are deceived because they do NOT study the Bible!

📖 2 Timothy 2:15 (KJV)
"Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth."

✔️ Many people just believe whatever their church teaches without checking if it’s biblical!
✔️ If you do not study the Bible for yourself, you will fall for lies!
✔️ A true Christian reads, understands, and OBEYS God's Word!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Bible is your ultimate guide—never let anyone tell you otherwise!
💡 QUESTION: How often do you read the Bible for yourself?

✅ 3. OBEY JESUS’ COMMANDS – DON’T JUST LISTEN TO THEM!
🔥 It’s not enough to HEAR God’s Word—you must LIVE it!

📖 James 1:22 (KJV)
"But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves."

✔️ Many people hear the truth but never apply it!
✔️ They say “Amen” in church, but ignore Jesus in their daily lives!
✔️ True Christians LIVE by the Word of God, not just talk about it!
🚨 THE TRUTH: If you don’t obey Jesus, your faith is WORTHLESS!
💡 QUESTION: Are you obeying Jesus daily, or just listening to His words without action?

✅ 4. SEPARATE YOURSELF FROM THE WORLD – LIVE A HOLY LIFE!
🔥 You CANNOT be a true Christian and love the world at the same time!

📖 1 John 2:15 (KJV)
"Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him."

✔️ Many so-called “Christians” live just like unbelievers!
✔️ They love sin more than they love Jesus!
✔️ If you truly follow Christ, your life will be different from the world!
🚨 THE TRUTH: You must choose—will you live for Christ, or will you follow the world?
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly set apart for God, or do you still love the world?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT WE KNOW HOW TO BE TRUE FOLLOWERS OF JESUS, WILL YOU MAKE THAT CHOICE TODAY?
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU FULLY COMMIT TO CHRIST, NO MATTER THE COST?

💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you know the truth, what will you do? Will you fully commit to Jesus Christ and His Word, or will you continue following religion, traditions, and the ways of the world?

📖 Luke 9:23 (KJV)
"And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me."

🚨 REALITY CHECK:
✔️ You cannot follow Jesus halfway—you must surrender completely!
✔️ Jesus said MANY will call Him ‘Lord’ but will be rejected! (Matthew 7:21-23)
✔️ A true Christian lives by Scripture, not by church traditions or human opinions!
🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
💡 QUESTION: Are you willing to obey Christ fully, even if it costs you relationships, comfort, or reputation?

🚨 MOST PEOPLE IGNORE THIS WARNING – DON’T BE ONE OF THEM!
📖 Hosea 4:6 (KJV)
"My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee."

🚨 THINK ABOUT THIS:
❌ Many believers today blindly accept what religious leaders tell them without checking the Bible.
❌ Some churches elevate human traditions above the Word of God.
❌ Satan is working overtime to keep people ignorant, deceived, and powerless!

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You must KNOW and STUDY the Bible for yourself—never take someone’s word for it!
✔️ You must EXPOSE false teachings, even when it’s unpopular!
✔️ You must be BOLD like Wycliffe and fight for the truth in these last days!
🚨 THE WARNING: If we stay silent, deception will continue to spread. If we compromise, we reject the example of the faithful warriors before us!
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready to be a modern-day reformer who brings people back to God’s Word?
🚀🔥 NOW THAT YOU KNOW THE TRUTH, WHAT WILL YOU DO?
🔥 This is your moment to act! Choose to stand firm, reject false teachings, and defend the true Gospel!
